tools.name: traceflow_create_cell
tools.description: Provision an isolated 30-minute in-memory cell returning write URLs (OTLP traces/metrics/logs, raw webhooks, CSP reports, HTTP/SSE chaos) and a separate read_token. Call this first to start any debugging or verification session; call traceflow_delete_cell when done to free subnet quota early. Cells

tools.name: traceflow_delete_cell
tools.description: Immediately destroy an active cell and wipe all in-memory spans, webhooks, chaos counters, and checkpoints before its 30-minute TTL expires. Use this after finishing verification to release per-subnet cell quota; use traceflow_save_mark instead if you want to keep the cell open and separate before/a

tools.name: traceflow_wait_events
tools.description: Long-poll a cell until at least expect_count new events arrive after after_seq, then return a token-budgeted causal anomaly digest. Use this instead of sleep loops or traceflow_get_digest when awaiting in-flight async webhooks, background OTLP batch flushes, or browser CSP reports; use traceflow_get

tools.name: traceflow_get_digest
tools.description: Return an immediate, non-blocking causal summary of a cell's latency percentiles, detected anti-patterns (N+1 SQL storms, floating async spans, lock herds, connection leaks, webhook HMAC/schema drift, chaos backoff grades), and saved MARKS checkpoints. Use this when events are already ingested; use

tools.name: traceflow_inspect_trace
tools.description: Render the chronological span waterfall, code file:line locations, SQL statements, and scrubbed error/exception logs for a single distributed trace in a cell. Use this after traceflow_get_digest or traceflow_wait_events identifies a slow critical path or error trace; do not use it for cell-wide p50/

tools.name: traceflow_save_mark
tools.description: Record a named sequence-number checkpoint (such as 'before') on a cell to partition baseline events from post-fix events. Call this after capturing baseline OTLP traces and prior to editing code so traceflow_compare_marks can compute a Before/After latency diff; saved marks are listed in traceflow_g

tools.name: traceflow_compare_marks
tools.description: Compare warm p50/p99 latency, spans/request, and error rates before vs after a checkpoint created by traceflow_save_mark, returning VERDICT (IMPROVED, REGRESSED, or UNCHANGED) and a paste-ready PR Proof Receipt. Use this after running post-fix traces to prove a patch worked; use traceflow_get_digest

tools.name: traceflow_audit_schema
tools.description: Measure per-turn context-window token cost and structural defects (missing descriptions, >380-token schemas, deep anyOf/oneOf unions) for an MCP tools/list JSON payload. Stateless and requires no cell_id. Use this when designing or trimming MCP server tool schemas; use traceflow_check_prompt_cache i

tools.name: traceflow_check_prompt_cache
tools.description: Hash fixed-width character chunks of an LLM prompt with SHA-256 across consecutive calls on a cell to pinpoint the exact character range where a dynamic timestamp, header, or ID invalidated KV prefix caching. Call at least twice on the same cell (turn 1 baseline, turn 2 candidate) to trigger PROMPT_

tools.name: traceflow_manage_wishlist
tools.description: List, propose, or upvote missing runtime debugging and protocol tools on the public Traceflow backlog. Call with action='list' before action='propose' to avoid duplicate slugs; pass cell_id and read_token from a cell with ingested events (seq > 0) to record a higher-trust verified_session vote along

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "traceflow_create_cell" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
